Luxury to Economy Segment:
Growth in Asian markets, particularly China and India, as well as the US, helped offset the shortfall from the Middle East and Europe, which 
were impacted by travel disruptions. ERW’s strategy is to focus on short-haul markets and group-based business during the conflicts to 
maintain business volume.
Budget Segment:
Thailand: Demand remained resilient with limited impact from corporate travel. 
Philippines: There was some slowdown in new bookings due to a decline in government and group business. 
Japan and South Korea: Lower tourist arrivals had some impact on performance but overall trend remain healthy.
Cost
Potential increases in electricity and other operating as well as construction costs will be partially offset by strict cost control measures 
across all properties as well as project cost management.
